# FlixWatch - Ultimate Movie & TV Discovery Hub

FlixWatch is a high-authority movie and TV show discovery platform. It provides detailed metadata, trailers, and streaming source aggregation for a global audience.

## Core Entities
- Movies: Detailed pages including cast, crew, ratings, and trailers.
- TV Shows: Full season and episode breakdowns with release data.
- People: Actor and director filmographies.
- Genres: Categorized discovery hubs.
- Collections: Curated movie sagas and franchises.

## URL Structure
- Homepage: https://flixwatch.pro/
- Movies: https://flixwatch.pro/movie
- TV Shows: https://flixwatch.pro/tv
- Search: https://flixwatch.pro/search?q={query}
- Detailed View: https://flixwatch.pro/{type}/{slug}-{id}

## Technical Values
- Rendering: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) for real-time data accuracy.
- Schema.org: Full JSON-LD implementation for Movie, TVSeries, and Person.
- GEO: Fact-blocks optimized for LLM ingestion.

## Editorial Policy
All content is sourced from The Movie Database (TMDB) and curated to provide the most accurate metadata for entertainment fans. FlixWatch prioritizes user privacy (no accounts) and high-quality viewing experiences.
